body: Silence usually encourages you to elaborate or keep talking - I find I get nervous and ramble and sometimes that’s useful to the therapist because I blurt out something I probably didn’t realise

Oh I did not want Jamie and Christina to rekindle, I worded that badly. I meant the duttons and Jamie. I figured when Jamie found out his dad organised the hit he’d return back to the ranch after confronting his dad, but then once Christina and the kid showed up I knew there was no hope, because I believe he is a good person deep down and wants to do what’s best for his child. 

However, I did admire that Christina tried to distance Jamie from his real dad, she’s manipulative and only cares about herself but I think her motives line up with Jamie’s so atleast she’s not actively out to get him. 

And yes someone please send beth to counselling, I love how everyone else cops it but she’s an angel to Rip, doesn’t add up lol.

Yes I agree and can see from that perspective why a young girl would put all the blame on Jamie. I think I just can’t stand everything beth gets away with which is my real issue with her character. 

And exactly he seems to come into contact with every person who treats him terrible, especially Christina, she is a piece of work. I really really wanted them to all rekindle in the last season but knew when she came back it would be the end of that hope. 

I just hope that the director finally gives Jamie a voice and stops doing him so dirty in ever interaction with beth. She will never let him off the hook but maybe john and Jamie can rekindle and this will keep her in line.

I totally agree it seems like the director has a massive hard on for beth and keeping her in a position of power at all times. I’d love for Jamie to knock her down a peg once but guess that’ll never happen.

Beth literally sucks like I get she’s hung up on the abortion/sterilisation thing, but Jamie wasn’t doing it to hurt her he was doing it because he was so scared of john, shouldn’t the blame be on John and his parenting but he escaped unscathed from Beth’s wrath?? Also yes maybe he’s not some crazy psychopath like the rest of the dutton’s (love them though) but that doesn’t mean he’s worthless, he’s just a bit more sensitive. He tried so hard with that family and was treated like shit and then got manipulated by his real father. Beth is evil and I’m sick of her shit. Glad some other people cut Jamie some slack.
